name: FATCA Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act (FATCA) status.

F101.name: FATCA 101
F101.definition: Account holder type is an owner-documented financial institution with specified US owner(s).

F102.name: FATCA 102
F102.definition: Account holder type is a passive non-financial entity with substantial US owner(s).

F103.name: FATCA 103
F103.definition: Account holder type is a non-participating financial institution.

F104.name: FATCA 104
F104.definition: Account holder type is a specified US person.

F105.name: FATCA 105
F105.definition: Account holder type is a direct reporting non-financial foreign entity (NFFE).

F201.name: FATCA 201
F201.definition: Account pool reporting type is a recalcitrant account holder with US indicia.

F202.name: FATCA 202
F202.definition: Account pool reporting type is a recalcitrant account holder without US indicia.

F203.name: FATCA 203
F203.definition: Account pool reporting type is a dormant account.

F204.name: FATCA 204
F204.definition: Account pool reporting type is a non-participating foreign financial institution.

F205.name: FATCA 205
F205.definition: Account pool reporting type is a recalcitrant account holder that is a US person.

F206.name: FATCA 206
F206.definition: Account pool reporting type is recalcitrant account holder that is a passive non-financial foreign entity (NFFE).
